about: Exemptions for scripts/check-secrets.mjs. An entry names a rule and an exact path and must carry a reason; the gate refuses an entry with no reason and refuses an entry whose rule no longer fires on that path, because a stale exemption silently covers whatever lands there next. Deliberately empty: the local development database credential is exempt structurally instead (check-secrets.mjs exempts loopback hosts, not the three files that happen to contain postgres://berelax:berelax@127.0.0.1 today), and the synthetic Google refresh tokens in packages/google are pnpm chokepoint's subject, not this gate's.
